headline_pain: What If You Could Pick Your Size?
primary_text: "There's literally nothing available to buy in the size range we need in the west." What if you didn't have to settle? Off-the-plan means you select the warehouse configuration that matches your business — not whatever scraps are left on the market. New Truganina warehouses come in a range of sizes built for small business owner-occupiers. Lock in now and settle when construction completes. Minutes from Princes Freeway, West Gate Tunnel, and Port of Melbourne. Why compromise on size when you can choose exactly what you need?
